character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: to expose corruption in federal offices

character_profile.name: Jane Smith

illegal.costs: If discovered, risks disbarment and legal penalties

legitimate.benefits: Earns money legally and builds reputation as a reliable investigator
